sources.title: How to Run the Laya Decision Model Entirely in Your Browser with ONNX ...
sources.snippet: Store downloaded ONNX weights in the browser’s CacheStorage or IndexedDB to prevent re-downloading across user sessions. Check navigator.gpu before launching sessions: if WebGPU is available, single-question decision latency drops to 25-35ms on consumer hardware.
